structured.answer: Harel has 105 products, and the one that stands out for me is the S&P 500 tracker. It's about 0.5% fee and around 13.7% a year over 3 years, and it shows up in קרן השתלמות, גמל להשקעה and the others. I'm not doing anything today because I can't tell what that fee is in shekels or which section is meant for someone like me.

stuck.where: Product buttons at top (105 products, 11 categories)
stuck.why: Too many groups; I didn't know which one is for a 26-year-old with 30k, so I just scrolled everything
'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so half the tracks have nothing to compare
Two fee numbers per row; in pension rows 0.16% and 1.47%, didn't know which one is the real cost
Numbers like 99% shares and 99% foreign currency, or 0% shares and 96% foreign currency, didn't make sense to me
Three fee lines (קבועים, משתנים, נאמן) and coloured tags I didn't understand
